title: csr output
description: The typed output of a CSR-gathering Apply (CERT-2): the target's PEM certificate-signing request, published by a play as `stratt_outputs.csr` and bound by the signing Step as {{.steps.<name>.outputs.csr}}. CLOSED (§9) and carrying exactly one field, which is the point: the private key that produced this CSR was generated on the target and never leaves it (§2.5, ADR-0050), and a schema that admitted anything else would be an invitation to send more. An Actuator pins this document via its `outputContract`; without a pin the hub REFUSES the outputs rather than capturing them, because a shape nobody agreed to cannot be handed to a downstream Step.
